coverage: Read the complete available local article body; linked images, videos and external claims not independently inspected.
basis: Practitioner account / proposed exercise; no direct causal evaluation of the extracted practice.
reported_outcomes: Author says the newsletter itself used the grading loop.
limits: Word count and presence of fields can be checked; truth, relevance and quality are different. No independently measured productivity or quality advantage. AI-first-for-every-question and ranking claims excluded.
review_note: Combines a genuinely checkable finish line with the claim that an AI grader’s 9+ score establishes completion.
author: Sabrina Ramonov
